title: Node history
description: Every version of a node with its notes, replies, proposals, park bundle, links, region and size; `linked` (only with `linked=true`) holds the nodes linked to it, one hop.

linked.description: The nodes linked to this one, each in full. Present only when `linked` is true.

ledger.description: The other ledger of the folder this was read from, when the read named one (`ledger`); it comes with `readOnly: true`. Left out for the open ledger.
